title: prunus × gigantea
intro: Prunus × gigantea, commonly known as Chinese cherry or giant cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Prunus × gigantea include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
